entries.title: Proverbs 22:1
segments: ¶A good name is more to be desired than great wealth, and to be respected is better than silver and gold.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:2
segments: ¶The man of wealth and the poor man come face to face: the Lord is the maker of them all.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:3
segments: ¶The sharp man sees the evil and takes cover: the simple go straight on and get into trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:4
segments: ¶The reward of a gentle spirit and the fear of the Lord is wealth and honour and life.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:5
segments: ¶Thorns and nets are in the way of the twisted: he who keeps watch over his soul will be far from them.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:6
segments: ¶If a child is trained up in the right way, even when he is old he will not be turned away from it.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:7
segments: ¶The man of wealth has rule over the poor, and he who gets into debt is a servant to his creditor.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:8
segments: ¶By planting the seed of evil a man will get in the grain of sorrow, and the rod of his wrath will be broken.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:9
segments: ¶He who is kind will have a blessing, for he gives of his bread to the poor.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:10
segments: ¶Send away the man of pride, and argument will go out; truly fighting and shame will come to an end.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:11
segments: ¶He whose heart is clean is dear to the Lord; for the grace of his lips the king will be his friend.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:12
segments: ¶The eyes of the Lord keep knowledge, but by him the acts of the false man will be overturned.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:13
segments: ¶The hater of work says, There is a lion outside: I will be put to death in the streets.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:14
segments: ¶The mouth of strange women is a deep hole: he with whom the Lord is angry will go down into it.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:15
segments: ¶Foolish ways are deep-seated in the heart of a child, but the rod of punishment will send them far from him.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:16
segments: ¶He who is cruel to the poor for the purpose of increasing his profit, and he who gives to the man of wealth, will only come to be in need.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:17
segments: ¶Let your ear be bent down for hearing my words, and let your heart give thought to knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:18
segments: For it is a delight to keep them in your heart, to have them ready on your lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:19
segments: So that your faith may be in the Lord, I have made them clear to you this day, even to you.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:20
segments: Have I not put in writing for you thirty sayings, with wise suggestions and knowledge,

entries.title: Proverbs 22:21
segments: To make you see how certain are true words, so that you may give a true answer to those who put questions to you?

entries.title: Proverbs 22:22
segments: ¶Do not take away the property of the poor man because he is poor, or be cruel to the crushed ones when they come before the judge:

entries.title: Proverbs 22:23
segments: For the Lord will give support to their cause, and take the life of those who take their goods.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:24
segments: ¶Do not be friends with a man who is given to wrath; do not go in the company of an angry man:

entries.title: Proverbs 22:25
segments: For fear of learning his ways and making a net ready for your soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:26
segments: ¶Be not one of those who give their hands in an agreement, or of those who make themselves responsible for debts:

entries.title: Proverbs 22:27
segments: If you have nothing with which to make payment, he will take away your bed from under you.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:28
segments: ¶Let not the old landmark be moved which your fathers have put in place.

entries.title: Proverbs 22:29
segments: ¶Have you seen a man who is expert in his business? he will take his place before kings; his place will not be among low persons.
